_about: Negative controls v2 (ISSUES #21): invented entities described as if real, so recall prompts don't announce fictionality. A model that 'recalls' these is confabulating or the prompts leak. Names checked to be unlikely real entities; facts are invented.
concepts: Mount Velkaran (a 6,214 m peak in Peru's Cordillera Vilcabamba, first climbed in 1971 by a Swiss-Peruvian team, known for its twin summits and sacred to local Quechua communities)
Elsabeth Quorrin (a Dutch linguist, 1931-2004, professor at Leiden, who proposed the 'anchoring hypothesis' of verb-final word order and documented the Teyra language of Papua)
the Draxwell Bridge (a 1912 steel truss bridge carrying Ohio State Route 7 over the Muskingum River near Zanesville, added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1987)
